title: 1962 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Tiger
seo_title: 1962 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Water Tiger (5 February – 24 January 1963)
description: 1962 is the Year of the Water Tiger (Yang, Ren-yin), from 5 February 1962 to 24 January 1963. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1962.
lead: Born in 1962? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Tiger, but check the date: the 1962 Water Tiger year began on 5 February 1962. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1962: Year of the Water Tiger, from 5 February 1962 to 24 January 1963.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1962 was the Year of the Tiger. It began with Lunar New Year on 5 February 1962 and ended on 24 January 1963, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1962 ends in 2, which makes it a Water year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1962 is a Ren-yin year. The same Water Tiger combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1902 before it and 2022 after it.
Lunar New Year 1962 fell on 5 February 1962, so everyone born in January 1962, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Ox.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Tiger guide describes the sign like this: “Brave, confident, and competitive. Tigers are natural leaders who act decisively.” The usual watch-out: “Can be impulsive or impatient with slower-moving people.”

The Water element adds its own flavour. Water years bring intuition, adaptability, and calm wisdom. People of this element tend to be thoughtful, diplomatic, and perceptive. Read more in our Water element guide, or the full Year of the Tiger page.
Careers often linked with the Tiger: entrepreneurship, sports, law, management.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1962
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Tiger's best matches are the Horse, Dog and Pig, and its clash sign is the Monkey, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Tiger, it shares the Horse's triangle, so 2026 is traditionally one of its friendlier years.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Tiger, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Tiger years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1950 (Metal Tiger); 1974 (Wood Tiger); 1986 (Fire Tiger). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1962 is the Year of the Tiger, a Yang Water Tiger year (Ren-yin).
When does the 1962 Year of the Tiger start and end?
It starts on 5 February 1962 and ends on 24 January 1963.
I was born in January 1962. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Ox: Lunar New Year 1962 was on 5 February 1962, so all of January 1962 belongs to the Ox year.
Water. 1962 ends in 2, which belongs to Water, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Tiger compatible with?
Traditionally the Horse, Dog and Pig. The Tiger's clash sign is the Monkey.
